notes: John O'Reilly's Confetti conference app — the phone catalog. Unlike the other joreilly imports, Confetti ALREADY applies ee.schimke.composeai.preview itself (build.gradle.kts, and :androidApp / :wearApp), pins it in its own version catalog, and publishes design-artifacts/confetti-mobile and design-artifacts/confetti-wear from its own workflow. Importing it here is therefore a second, independent path to the same catalog rather than the only one — worth having because it proves the import lane against a project that carries the plugin, and because it does not depend on the upstream workflow continuing to run. The specs are copied from the upstream catalog.mobile.spec.json with `system` repointed at this slug; the previews they name live in androidApp/src/main, which is the only source set the plugin discovers. Rendering is the Android/Robolectric lane: these are AndroidX @Preview functions in an application module, not commonMain CMP ones. Confetti applies the plugin itself and pins composeai-preview to 1.14.1; the CLI skips injection for a module that already has it, so that version wins. cliVersion "catalog" pins the CLI to the same one rather than pairing a current CLI with a 1.14.1 plugin — what Confetti's own workflow does, and what /status.json shows built the confetti-* catalogs being served today. Split from the Wear catalog because the pipeline renders one module per import.
